fields.summary: TC-LCO-018: LCO Decision Matrix - Overfly - Originals - Involuntary

content.text: Linked Story: LCO Decision Matrix
Precondition: Crew member is assigned as original working crew on flight 123 HOU-DAL with a planned stop at AUS. Change type is Involuntary. isOriginal = TRUE.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with original working assignment on flight 123 HOU-DAL with planned stop at AUS
Flight 123 HOU-DAL, planned stop AUS, legType=Flying, isOriginal=TRUE, changeType=Involuntary
Crew member is set up as original working crew on flight 123 HOU-DAL
Apply an involuntary Overfly - crew overflies the planned AUS stop and continues past it
OF event, changeType=Involuntary, flight 123 HOU-DAL overflies planned AUS stop
Involuntary Overfly is applied and COA records are generated
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the COA Overfly record shows OV 123 HOU-DAL
COA Flight (OV) field in COA record
COA Flight (OV): 123 HOU-DAL is present with OV marker
Verify the COA continuation flight shows 123 HOU-AUS (from planned stop to next segment)
COA Flight (continuation) field in COA record
COA Flight (continuation): 123 HOU-AUS is present
Verify LCO is applicable for this involuntary overfly scenario on an original leg
LCO field in COA record
LCO: Applicable. lcoCode is set correctly for this leg.
